race.title: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: DOUBLY BLESSED shaped well when beaten only by a good prospect in a Kelso bumper and he could be capable of going one better as he makes his hurdling/stable debut. Throatlash was placed twice over this C&D prior to going chasing and he is the pick for second back over hurdles, while Hurlyburly is also considered. DOUBLY BLESSED (IRE) THROATLASH (IRE) HURLYBURLY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Doubly Blessed (4/7), Get Out Of My Way (2/1), Throatlash (9/2), Abbey Farmer (10/1), Hurlyburly (12/1), Linalene (14/1), Handball Maradona (25/1), Kapoutchino (25/1), The Foreman (25/1), Aye Over Tee (33/1), Lecanvey Lady (100/1)
